title: Matemágico · Nen curiós
description: Gerard's own ánima grows with him: as a boy (chapter 1) it is called Nen curiós, in Catalan, with its own motto; at 35 it is Matemágico, and in fights whoever wears it thinks out loud: two ghostly little birds glide round the head while light bulbs and question marks of soft light drift up out of it and fade. Exploring, nothing shows.

steps.caption: Chapter 1: the boy's ánima is Nen curiós, "Tot ho pregunta. Fins i tot el que no cal."
At 35 the same ánima is Matemágico
Exploring at 35 with Matemágico on: nothing over his head, the ánima shows in fights
In a fight Gerard swaps to Matemágico (Q): birds of light glide round his head and a thought drifts up
A moment later: the thoughts fade in, rise and dissolve
And again: bulbs and question marks, never the same
